verdicts.note: Pamphlet pledge to "oppose new taxes, fight the unconstitutional income tax" [S1] plus nay votes on ESHB 2081 and ESSB 5814 [S7][S8] are independent of ESSB 6346; roll call re-checked (Marshall nay).
First-term incumbent (records 2025-26 only) and former school director; -1 rather than -2 correctly reflects short tenure.

Neither cited statement is a position on state mandates or regional authority: opposing "any mega airport here" [S1] is a siting preference, and keeping an elected sheriff is about how a county office is filled (closer to reform/direct election) than about state-vs-local control. Direction plausible, evidence indirect: lower to low.

The site text behind "fight for healthcare for all" [S2] is "lower the cost of essential medications and expand access to affordable, reliable healthcare options for all residents" and a centralized rural hospital; those are within-system (pole_a-leaning) measures, and nothing in S1 or S2 names universal public coverage or single payer. The +1 rests on a slogan; omit.
Endorsement-only evidence; low confidence is the correct ceiling.
